searchLog: Read life/PIPELINE.md, life/PROFILE.md, life/OUTLOOK.md, and this repo's profile.md and data/target-companies.json/applications.json/history/sent-log.json first. Attempted to fetch 15+ candidate pages (Ramp, Cohere, Cursor/Anysphere, Harvey, Perplexity, Together AI, Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, OpenAI, Meta, Notion, Microsoft AI, Vercel, Linear, Sierra, Google, LinkedIn, YC, Wikipedia, BBC) via Ashby/Greenhouse JSON APIs and each company's own site. Every one returned EGRESS_BLOCKED from the sandbox's network proxy; only anthropic.com and github.com were reachable. Confirmed this is a systemic environment restriction, not per-page failures, via direct curl (connect_rejected/403 at the proxy) and repeated WebFetch tests. Anthropic's own careers page (reachable) shows three open 'Anthropic Fellows Program' listings, but excluded them: Dom was already rejected from an Anthropic Fellows cohort (PIPELINE.md, Jun 15 close) and the underlying application page (job-boards.greenhouse.io) was itself unreachable to confirm this is a genuinely distinct cohort/track rather than a repeat. No other candidate could be verified at all. Per the honesty rules, zero unverifiable opportunities is the correct output rather than including anything sourced only from a search snippet or an unreachable board.
